notes.desc: A Gemini-built simulator screenshot: six nodes around a hexagon with the Alpha–Omega Hamiltonian readouts (alpha limit, entropy, Hamiltonian balance); the error-correction switch is off.
The same simulator with error correction active: the correction field and the entropy field are drawn, the Hamiltonian balance readout is held.
Simulator screenshot of the black-hole/white-hole transition at the collapsing-spacetime end: event horizon marked, causality and time-dilation controls.
The expansion end of the same transition: a glowing cosmic-expansion core inside the horizon rings.
Simulator screenshot: a lattice of points and the Planck-energy ring at a low Fermat exponent.
The same simulator at a high exponent: the lattice fills the field and the ring closes.
Simulator screenshot: points converging into a spiral under rotation and entropy controls; event horizon marked.
The same simulator with natural markers on: five arms form.
Simulator screenshot: a horizon disc with the integration speed, entropy pressure and horizon scale controls.
Simulator screenshot: the zeta spiral with the zeros plotted and an unmapping-factor control (below, the line spectrum).
Simulator screenshot: a Riemann wave crossing the event horizon between the Riemann-space and Fermat-space lattices.
